quirks.condition: Status H record in state CA or NY whose period gross is strictly greater than 250000 cents
quirks.effect: The top marginal federal rate on the portion above 400000 cents is 32% instead of the spec's 30%; status H elsewhere, other statuses in CA or NY, and a gross of exactly 250000 use 30%.

quirks.condition: Any accepted record, judged on the employee's year-to-date gross accumulated before the record
quirks.effect: If the prior year-to-date gross is below 1600000 cents the 6.2% levy is charged on the record's full gross, so the record that crosses the cap pays on all of it; once the prior year-to-date gross is at or above the cap the levy is 0. The spec prorates the crossing record to the portion under the cap.

Federal tax is computed at the unrelieved rates and rounded half-even to a cent, then multiplied by 92% and rounded half-even again; the spec applies the 8% relief to the rates and rounds once to the nearest cent.
State tax is 0 cents, the same as the four documented zero-tax states TX, FL, WA, NV; the spec lists only those four, so SD would be taxed at 5%.

quirks.condition: Flags token containing both the letter X and the letter B, in any position
quirks.effect: An extra 1% of gross, rounded half-up to a cent, is added to the levy regardless of the year-to-date cap; the spec says flags never affect withholding.
The record is accepted and federal tax uses halved bracket thresholds of 50000 and 200000 cents; the spec allows only periods 01 to 26 and would reject with PERIOD.
The record is rejected with code GROSS and counted in the rejected column; the spec treats it as an accepted no-op with net 0.

quirks.condition: Employee id that matches an earlier id in the batch ignoring letter case
quirks.effect: Year-to-date gross accumulates under one shared key and the result line echoes the first-seen spelling of the id; the spec says ids are case-sensitive.

quirks.condition: Federal or state amount whose exact value lands on a half cent
quirks.effect: Federal tax and state tax are rounded half-to-even to the cent while the levy and the recapture amount round half-up; the spec says nearest cent for all three, which a literal reading takes as half-up throughout.

quirks.condition: Record line with more than seven whitespace-separated tokens, or an FMT failure with an unusable id token
quirks.effect: Tokens after the seventh are ignored and the record is processed normally; an FMT reject echoes the id token when it is 1 to 8 alphanumerics and eight question marks otherwise. The spec defines exactly seven fields.
